# Danny McGiffin

Danny McGiffin is an independent tech advisor based in Herndon, Virginia. He works with owners and executives of established, growing businesses on technology spending, major system decisions, connecting existing systems, and where AI is worth the money.

He is vendor-neutral. He does not sell software or receive commissions, referral fees, or resale margins, so the answer can be new software, integration, better data, process change, clearer ownership, a different vendor, or no purchase at all.

## Services

- Tech Audit ($5,000 fixed fee, 10 business days): what your software and subscriptions actually cost, how to make the most of what you have, and where to focus next. https://dannymcgiffin.com/tech-audit/
- Second Opinion (from $2,500, fixed quote, 5 business days): an independent decision on a major system purchase or troubled implementation: proceed, proceed with changes, or stop. https://dannymcgiffin.com/second-opinion/
- AI Opportunity ($5,000 fixed fee, 10 business days): a ranked map of where AI is worth pursuing, what needs more evidence, and what to leave alone. https://dannymcgiffin.com/ai-opportunity/
- Data Connection (from $7,500, fixed quote, typically 3–6 weeks): connect the systems a business already has so the numbers line up, without buying a new platform. https://dannymcgiffin.com/data-connection/

Tech Audit, Second Opinion, and AI Opportunity carry a money-back guarantee described on each page. Every engagement starts with a free 30-minute introduction.

## Location

Based in Herndon. Works with businesses across Northern Virginia and the Washington, DC area. Service locations are not separate offices.

## Experience

The case study pages distinguish Danny's role from team and organization-level results. The alternative ERP design's cost is an estimate, not measured savings. No guaranteed business outcome is offered.
